preconditions.description: The number of servers is at least 3 and at most 105.
The number of direct connections is at most 105.
The index of the server that fails is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (1 <= len(output) <= m and all(len(conn) == 2 and 1 <= conn[0] < conn[1] <= n for conn in output))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a list of direct connections, each described by a pair of server indexes, with each pair containing two different servers and each pair appearing at most once.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (all(v not in G[u] or v not in G[w] for (u, w) in output) for G in graphs(output, n))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, then for every graph formed by the output connections, the server with index v is not part of any cycle, ensuring that the system remains connected even if the server with index v fails.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (all(u in G[w] and w in G[u] for (u, w) in output) for G in graphs(output, n))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, then for every graph formed by the output connections, every pair of connected servers are mutually reachable.
